1. INTRODUCTION
These terms govern the reservation of a pistol to try at the Česká zbrojovka Days event. This is a school demo app and the reservation has no legal effect.

2. MAKING A RESERVATION
A reservation is created by confirming the pistol, extras and time slot. The same pistol cannot be reserved by two people for overlapping times. The firearms license information is for reference only.

3. PRICE
The price covers the loan of the selected pistol and extras for the reserved time slot. The final price on site may differ.

4. SAFETY
Shooting takes place only at the range and under the supervision of an authorised person. Participants must follow the range staff's instructions and safety rules.

5. CANCELLATION
A reservation can be cancelled until the start of the reserved time slot. If you do not show up, the slot may be given to other participants.

6. FINAL PROVISIONS
Matters not covered by these terms are governed by Czech law.
